name: Bridlewise
promise: Every claim comes with a receipt.
summary: Bridlewise is a free, open-source, local-first cockpit for AI coding runs. Every claim it makes about itself links to the check that backs it, and a claim whose check fails is struck out automatically.
repository: This repository is the development floor: the source of Bridlewise together with every test, prevention guard, benchmark and decision record. The product repository is projected from it.
status: Developer preview. Not production-ready, not audited, not for sensitive code.
description: Where Bridlewise, a free, local-first cockpit for AI coding runs, is built and verified. Every public claim links to the check that backs it, and a claim whose check fails is retracted automatically. Developer preview: not production-ready, not for sensitive code.
